notes.title: Become the Supervillain
notes.content:
Hello,

I'm happy and nervous at the same time to announce the launch of Conquer Humanity Early Access!
The game is only made by me and the idea behind it is to create a concept that, if there are positive early response, could turn into a fully fledge game.

I'm sure a lot of you might have certain expectations from the game and I'm aware that the game needs a little bit more to be fully realised as a fully engaging experience, hence the very low price and the reason why I'm nervous.

I'm sure I'll receive negative feedback but I hope the unique concept and the moments of fun make up for it and turns this into a positive experience :)

Having said that, I can't wait to see how you guys will react to the concept and hopefully support the game for further updates.

[b]Discord Invite Link : [/b]https://discord.gg/5FDRcMsQw8


[b]Press Kit[/b] : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18b5nr0nBxE9AltGzKCki7Tbuys48kJGI?usp=share_link

notes.title: Conquer Humanity Launch
notes.content:
Hello,

Time has come to release Conquer Humanity on Early Access the [b]14th of July 2023[/b]!

This is a bit on a nervous release because I'm aware that the game has more room to grow and it might not be suitable for everyone :)

I'm releasing this concept mainly too see what reaction it draws and hopefully builds up into something that I'll update with more content and features.

I'm looking forward to the feedback and I'm ready for some harsh ones :)
I hope you enjoy the concept!

Let's go Supervillains!

notes.title: Conquer Humanity Live Stream
notes.content:
Hello,

I'm happy and nervous at the same time to announce that I'm taking part of Steam Next Fest livestream showcasing the Demo of Conquer Humanity.

Why nervous ? Well I'm aware the demo has a lot more work needed but at the same time this is a great opportunity to get feedback early and improve as a solo dev :)

Please check out the Demo and post any feedback either in the chat or the Steam Community Hub.

Cya at the stream!
